info.title: DocReader PoC API
info.description:
Local proof of concept for document ingestion, OCR, classification and extraction.

**There is no authentication.** Every endpoint is anonymous, the Swagger page is public and
no bearer token is required. Do not expose this API to the internet and do not send real
personal documents to it. Use synthetic, masked or authorized files only.

Conventions: JSON in camelCase, timestamps in UTC ISO 8601, errors as
`application/problem+json`, and an `X-Correlation-Id` header on every response.

Stage 3 of the execution plan delivers upload, listing, detail, content, deletion, OCR
(PP-OCRv5 on CPU, see ADR 0002), the raw text and the structured result of seven document
types: CPF card, CIN/RG, CNH, proof of address, CNPJ card, CCMEI and social contract.
Other document types are read as raw text only.

post.summary: Receives a document and queues it for processing.
post.description:
The response is asynchronous on purpose: the API stores the original, issues the protocol and
answers `202 Accepted` with a `Location` header, while OCR, classification and
extraction run in the worker. Poll `statusUrl` to follow the document.
            
Accepted formats are PDF, PNG, JPEG and TIFF, checked by the real file signature rather than
by the announced content type. Size and page limits are configurable and answer 413 and 422.
            
Send the optional `Idempotency-Key` header to make a retry safe: the same key with the
same file replays the original response, and the same key with a different file answers 409.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional replay protection key.

parameters.name: X-Upload-Channel
parameters.description:
Origin of the upload, `WEB` or `API`. The interface sends WEB; anything else
defaults to API.

File.description:
The document itself. PDF, PNG, JPEG or TIFF, validated by its real signature and not by the
announced content type.

ExpectedDocumentType.description:
Optional hint about the document type. It never overrides the classifier; a divergence is
recorded instead.

ExternalReference.description: Optional reference of the calling system, echoed back in every response.

example.detail: The request could not be completed. Check the API logs using the correlation id of this response.

400.description: The request is malformed or a field is invalid.

example.title: One or more validation errors occurred
example.detail: Check the errors property for the fields that were refused.

409.description: The Idempotency-Key was already used with a different file.

example.title: Idempotency-Key conflict
example.detail: This Idempotency-Key was already used with a different file. Use a new key or resend the original file.

413.description: The file is above the configured size limit.

example.title: File too large
example.detail: The uploaded file has 41943040 bytes and the limit is 26214400 bytes.

415.description: The real signature is not an accepted format, or contradicts the declared type.

example.title: Unsupported media type
example.detail: Only PDF, PNG, JPEG and TIFF files are accepted.

422.description: The file is an accepted format but unreadable or above the page limit.

example.title: Content cannot be processed
example.detail: The document has 84 pages and the limit is 50 pages.

get.description:
Every filter is optional and they combine with AND. `page` starts at 1 and
`pageSize` is capped by the configured maximum. The envelope carries
`totalCount` and `totalPages` so a client can paginate without guessing.

parameters.description: Full or partial protocol, case insensitive.

parameters.name: fileName
parameters.description: Full or partial original file name, case insensitive.

parameters.name: documentType
parameters.description: Detected or expected document type, matched exactly.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Upload channel: WEB or API.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
Status: RECEIVED, STORED, QUEUED, PREPROCESSING, OCR_RUNNING, CLASSIFYING, EXTRACTING,
COMPLETED, FAILED or REJECTED.

parameters.name: uploadedFrom
parameters.description: Lower bound of the upload instant, inclusive, ISO 8601 in UTC.

parameters.name: uploadedTo
parameters.description: Upper bound of the upload instant, inclusive, ISO 8601 in UTC.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: One based page number. Defaults to 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Items per page. Defaults to the configured page size and is capped by the maximum.

delete.summary: DESTRUCTIVE AND IRREVERSIBLE — Deletes a document permanently.
delete.description:
Removes the row, the timeline, the processing jobs, the idempotency keys bound to it and the
stored original. There is no soft delete and no recovery; the interface asks for confirmation
before calling this endpoint.

get.summary: Serves the original file exactly as it was received.
get.description:
The default is `Content-Disposition: inline`, so a browser renders the PDF or the image
in place. Add `?download=true` to force a download. The original stays available even
when processing failed, which is a hard requirement of the PoC.

parameters.description: Identity of the document.

parameters.name: download
parameters.description: True to answer with an attachment instead of inline content.

example.detail: The document metadata exists but the stored file is gone.

get.summary: Returns the raw text the OCR read, page by page.
get.description:
The text is exactly what the OCR produced, in reading order, with nothing corrected or
interpreted. It belongs to the latest extraction: while a reprocessing runs, the previous text
stays available and `status` tells what is happening now. Answers 409 while there is
nothing to return yet, or when every attempt failed.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Identity of the document.

example.title: Unexpected error
example.detail: The request could not be completed. Check the API logs using the correlation id of this response.

example.title: Document not found
example.detail: No document matches the requested identifier.

409.description: The document has no result yet, or its processing failed.

example.title: Result not available
example.detail: The document is OCR_RUNNING and has no result yet. Poll the status endpoint and try again when it is COMPLETED.

get.summary: Explains how the document was classified, for debugging a document that came out UNKNOWN.
get.description:
Runs the classifier again, with the rules in force now, over the text of the latest extraction. For
every document type it tried, it reports the score, the threshold, each evidence found or missing
(with the rule pattern that matched and whether OCR errors had to be tolerated) and a sentence
saying why the type was or was not accepted. `recorded` is what was stored when the document
was processed; it differs from `current` after the rules changed, until the document is
reprocessed. Nothing is written. The raw text is included by default because it is the first thing
to look at; it is the same content as `/text`, and `includeText=false` leaves it out.
Answers 409 while there is nothing to return yet, or when every attempt failed.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Identity of the document.

parameters.name: includeText
parameters.description: Whether to include the raw OCR text. Defaults to true.

get.description:
Each field carries the value as read (`raw`), the normalized value, a confidence between
0 and 1, a validation status (`VALID`, `INVALID`, `NOT_FOUND` or
`UNCERTAIN`) with machine readable messages such as `CHECK_DIGIT_VALID`, and the
evidence (page and bounding box in pixels of the analysed page image). A field that was not
found is null, never invented. Answers 409 while there is nothing to return yet, or when
every attempt failed.

post.summary: Runs the pipeline again on a document that is already stored.
post.description:
Creates a new processing attempt and a new extraction; previous results are kept. The original
file is never touched. A document that is already queued or being processed answers 409, so
the same document is never processed twice at once.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Identity of the document.

example.title: Unexpected error
example.detail: The request could not be completed. Check the API logs using the correlation id of this response.

202.description: Queued again. Poll `statusUrl` to follow it.

example.title: Document not found
example.detail: No document matches the requested identifier.

409.description: The document is already queued or being processed.

example.title: Document already being processed
example.detail: The document is queued or being processed, or it was rejected. Wait for it to finish before reprocessing.

documentType.description: Type this candidate would classify the document as.

score.description: Evidence found minus counter-evidence, between 0 and 1.

threshold.description: Score needed to accept the type.

accepted.description: Whether the score reached the threshold.

reason.description: Why the score is what it is.

evidence.description: Every evidence of the type, found or not.

counterEvidence.description: Every counter-evidence of the type, found or not.

classifierVersion.description: Version of the rules that ran now.

documentType.description: The decision, UNKNOWN when no type reached its threshold.

confidence.description: Score of the chosen type; null when UNKNOWN.

minimumScoreOverride.description: Global minimum score in force, null when each type uses its own threshold.

textLength.description: Letters and digits the matcher worked with.

extractedAt.description: Instant the text was persisted, in UTC.

candidates.description: Every document type tried, best score first.

pages.description: Raw OCR text, page by page. Omitted with `includeText=false`.

ClassificationDiagnosticsResponse.description:
Why a document was classified as it was: the classification recorded at processing time, the same
decision recomputed with the rules in force now, every document type that was tried with its score and
evidence, and the raw text of the latest extraction.

current.reason: BR_CIN chosen with score 0.85 (threshold 0.60), best of 7 types tried.

candidates.reason: Score 0.85 reached the threshold 0.60. Found: title, republic, registration-number, birth-date, parentage, issue-date.

pages.text:
REPUBLICA FEDERATIVA DO BRASIL
REGISTRO DE IDENTIDADE CIVIL
DATA DE NASC / DATE OF BIRTH
FILUACAO

weight.description: Points added, or removed for counter-evidence.

matched.description: Whether it was found in the text.

matchedPattern.description: Rule pattern that matched; not document content.

matchKind.description: EXACT, or FUZZY when OCR errors were tolerated.

edits.description: Errors tolerated for a FUZZY match.

DocumentDetailResponse.description:
Consolidated view of a document. Classification and extraction stay null until the worker has
produced them; the original file is always available regardless.

message.description: Short operator facing description, never document content.

ocrModelVersion.description: Pipeline and library versions, for reproducibility.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the schema used for the fields; null when the type has no extractor.

extractedAt.description: Instant the result was persisted, in UTC.

text.description: Raw OCR text, page by page.

reprocess.description: POST here to run the pipeline again.

DocumentLinks.description: Endpoints related to one document, so a client never has to build paths by hand.

attempt.description: Attempt in course or the last one that ran; 0 before the first is acquired.

maxAttempts.description: Attempts allowed before a transient failure becomes definitive.

pagesCompleted.description: Pages already read in the current attempt.

pageCount.description: Pages the attempt has to read, known once the worker starts.

nextAttemptAt.description: Earliest moment of the next attempt, in UTC, while a retry is scheduled.

DocumentProcessingResponse.description:
Where the asynchronous work of a document stands: which attempt, how many pages were read and,
when a retry is scheduled, when it will run. It is what makes a long document look alive instead
of stuck.

confidence.description: Confidence between 0 and 1; null when UNKNOWN.

extractorVersion.description: Version of the extraction rules; null when the type has no extractor.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the schema of the fields; null when the type has no extractor.

extractedAt.description: Instant the result was persisted, in UTC.

fields.description: Fields by name; empty when the document type has no extractor.

DocumentResultResponse.description:
Canonical result of PRD section 15: what was received, what the document was identified as and
the fields read from it, each with its raw and normalized value, confidence, validation status
and evidence.

fileName.description: Original file name as sent by the client.

externalReference.description: Caller reference sent at upload time.

DocumentStatus.description: Lifecycle of a document, as defined by RF-007 of the PRD.

detectedDocumentType.description: Type identified by the classifier, when available.

DocumentStatusResponse.description: Lightweight payload for polling, cheap enough to be called every couple of seconds.

fileName.description: Original file name as sent by the client.

mimeType.description: MIME type detected from the file signature.

expectedDocumentType.description: Type hint sent at upload time, when any.

detectedDocumentType.description: Type identified by the classifier, null until the document is classified.

externalReference.description: Caller reference sent at upload time, when any.

items.description: Items of the current page, newest first.

totalCount.description: Total number of items matching the filters.

totalPages.description: Number of pages for the current page size.

text.description: Text of the page, one recognized line per line.

extractedAt.description: Instant the text was persisted, in UTC.

DocumentTextResponse.description: The raw text the OCR read, page by page, in reading order. Nothing was interpreted or corrected.

eventType.description: Event name, for example RECEIVED or QUEUED.

fileName.description: Original file name as sent by the client.

externalReference.description: Caller reference sent at upload time.

expectedDocumentType.description: Type hint sent at upload time.

mimeType.description: MIME type detected from the file signature.

raw.description: Value exactly as read from the document.

normalized.description: Normalized value; null when the field was not found or did not validate.

validationMessages.description: Machine readable codes that explain the status, such as CHECK_DIGIT_VALID.

page.description: One based page of the evidence; null when the field was not found.

boundingBox.description: Flat x/y pairs of the text polygon, in pixels of the analysed page image.

detectedType.description: Type stored with the document; UNKNOWN or null when none was found.

classifierVersion.description: Rules version of the latest extraction.

contentUrl.description: Endpoint that serves the original file.

UploadAcceptedResponse.description:
Body of the 202 answered by the upload endpoint. The document is persisted and queued; the OCR
runs afterwards, outside the request.

UploadChannel.description: How the document entered the system.

tags.name: Documents
tags.description:
Ingestion and consultation of documents. Every endpoint is anonymous in this proof of concept:
there is no login, no bearer token and no tenant.
